title: Gilded Reliquary
description: Gilded Reliquary reimagines contemporary fashion portraiture through the atmosphere of a timeworn medieval painting. Muted olive grounds, devotional stillness, and symbolic gestures—an apple, a vessel, a stream of milk—move between the photographed body and an AIGC-constructed pictorial world. Drag each divider to reveal the original photograph beneath the final composite.

The garment was designed and handcrafted by Lara. Jasmin Xinjie Jiang conceived and led the shoot, shaping its visual language and overseeing the lighting, photography, post-production, and final synthesis of AIGC imagery with the original photographs.
